associate_tag_note: Left blank on purpose, and that is now a deliberate gate rather than an absence. A Selected Tracking ID (shopnow047c-20) was supplied on 2026-11-17; it is recorded in data/link-intent.json and published on the product-link register. It has NOT been written here, because setting this field makes scripts/build_site.py append it to every outbound link in site/ at once - scaling five unvalidated links before one has been confirmed. Amazon requires the tag as a URL parameter on every Special Link (Program Policies, Participation Requirements section 2(b)). Sequence: confirm the ID under Manage your Tracking IDs, generate one Special Link per product with it, confirm the destination and the tracking report for one, then set this field and rebuild. See flag F79 and suggestion SG-38.
